datasets.label: Empirical distribution known answer
datasets.description: An exact discrete empirical distribution containing one hundred copies of every integer from zero through nine.

provenance.origin: Deterministic closed-form PT2B fixture

knownAnswers.claim: Every integer from zero through nine occurs exactly one hundred times.
knownAnswers.derivation: The value is id modulo ten over exactly one thousand rows.

knownAnswers.claim: The arithmetic mean is 4.5.
knownAnswers.derivation: The mean of the equally weighted integers zero through nine is 4.5.

knownAnswers.claim: The R7 25th percentile is 2.
knownAnswers.derivation: R7 interpolation at index 249.75 lies within the one hundred repeated values equal to 2.

knownAnswers.claim: The R7 median is 4.5.
knownAnswers.derivation: The two central observations are 4 and 5.

knownAnswers.claim: The R7 75th percentile is 7.
knownAnswers.derivation: R7 interpolation at index 749.25 lies within the one hundred repeated values equal to 7.

knownAnswers.claim: The source graph contains exactly one thousand directed edges.
knownAnswers.derivation: Every node has exactly one committed source edge to the next node in its community cycle.

knownAnswers.claim: The graph has exactly four weakly connected components.

knownAnswers.claim: Every node has directed in-degree one and out-degree one.
knownAnswers.derivation: Each directed cycle contributes one incoming and one outgoing source edge per node.

knownAnswers.claim: Every source node_id equals the durable DatasetJSON row ID at the same row position.
knownAnswers.derivation: The generator emits node_id and rowIds from the same closed-form zero-padded identity sequence.
